decisions.reason: The charting bundle builds directly on the firm's core map.apps platform and its rapid release cycle showed the firm can learn from user feedback, but its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 raises some risk that it has been folded in or faded.

As the flagship platform resting on the firm's core GIS engineering knowledge, research and standards work, it remains central to the firm's direction even though it was less visible on the website recently.

Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's GIS competence and serves both public and private customers, so the firm can still interpret results and improve it, though its missing web presence lowers confidence.

The search extension overlaps with the search plugin already withdrawn in 2019 and has not been visible since 2018, so the firm learns little more from it and its resources are better used for the platform and new development.
